planSub: Copy the plan from your coach — a file, a message, or just text. I'll understand and organize everything.
planPlaceholder:
For example:

Workout A - Chest/Shoulders/Triceps
Warm-up: 5 minutes bike + stretching

1. Barbell bench press - 4 sets, 8-10 reps, rest 90s
2. Cable fly - 3 sets, 12-15 reps
3. Seated shoulder press - 3 sets, 10-12 reps
4. Cable tricep pushdown - 3 sets, 12-15 reps
